_readme: The launcher's front page. Commit a change here and players see it on
their next launch -- no release, no rebuild, no token.
Read from:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reBalance-Of-Souls/reBalanceOfSouls.github.io/main/news.json
Each item needs a title. image, link and kind are optional:
title  the caption under the art. Keep it to one line.
image  full URL to the artwork. Use PNG -- Windows decodes anything,
but the Linux build needs PNG, so PNG keeps one file working
on both. Committing art next to this file is fine.
link   opened in the player's browser when they click the item.
kind   news | changelog | shoutout. Free text; anything unknown is
still shown rather than dropped.
Items appear in the order written -- first is shown first.
Keys starting with _ are ignored by the launcher, including this one.
If this file is ever broken, the launcher refuses it by name and falls
back to the last copy that parsed, so a bad edit will not blank the
front page. A single malformed item is skipped and the rest still show.
Bump schema only if the launcher's own format changes -- not for content.
The YouTube images below are that video's own thumbnail. maxresdefault
is the 1280x720 one, which is the size the front page wants; if a video
has no maxres upload the URL 404s and the item simply shows with no art.
Swap in art of your own whenever you have it.
